fields.description: Windsor House II is a separate Ellington development in Dubai South, arranged as two L-shaped residential buildings around a landscaped courtyard. Studios through three-bedroom apartments sit alongside ground-floor retail, with fitness, Pilates and family recreation spaces planned within the scheme.
